description: Repairs the registration pages of a webinar. It fixes content that was saved twice encoded and replaces a placeholder webinar id that pages copied from another campaign still carry, so a page shows this webinar's form and date. Take it when a page behaves strangely. A host says: "The page shows a wrong date and the form is empty." It needs the session and the webinar. It writes on your site, participants see a working page again, and nothing else on the campaign changes. This is the repair for a broken page, not the way to change a text; for a wording use wi_change_webinar_text. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: broken page, wrong date on the page, empty form, raw characters

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_repair_webinar_pages
title: Repair a webinar's broken pages
